llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must call `requestPermission` from `useCameraPermissions()` only from a user-triggered action (for example `Pressable.onPress`), not on initial mount.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: requestPermission is only called inside handleOpen (triggered by Pressable.onPress) and inside the AppState listener (foreground refresh), never directly on mount.
evidence: handleOpen is bound to Pressable onPress
No useEffect calls requestPermission on initial mount unconditionally

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must support denied and blocked flows by retrying with `requestPermission` and using `Linking.openSettings()` when `permission.canAskAgain` is false.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The denied branch only shows 'Open Settings' and 'Go Back'; it does not offer a retry via requestPermission when permission.canAskAgain is true. Both retryable-denied and blocked cases are collapsed into a single 'denied' flow state with no retry button.
evidence: flow === 'denied' renders only handleOpenSettings and handleBack buttons
No Pressable calling requestPermission in the denied UI

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must refresh permission state on app foreground with `AppState.addEventListener('change', ...)` and a permission refresh call (`getPermission` / `getCameraPermissionsAsync`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: AppState.addEventListener('change', ...) is used in a useEffect to detect foreground transitions and calls requestPermission() to refresh permission status.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render a deterministic fallback `View`/`Text` path when permission is unavailable instead of rendering `CameraView`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: When permission is not granted, the component renders fallback View/Text UI (idle/requesting screen or denied screen) without rendering CameraView.
evidence: CameraView only rendered when flow === 'granted' && permission?.granted
Separate View+Text fallback branches for denied and idle states

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must prevent concurrent permission requests by guarding `requestPermission` with an in-flight state (for example `requesting`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The 'requesting' flow state disables the Pressable button, but the AppState listener unconditionally calls requestPermission() even while flow === 'requesting', allowing a concurrent in-flight request from foreground events.
evidence: AppState listener calls requestPermission() without checking flow state
disabled={flow === 'requesting'} only guards the button, not the AppState path

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render `CameraView` only when `permission.granted` is true, with deterministic denied/blocked fallback UI otherwise.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: CameraView is rendered only inside the branch guarded by both flow === 'granted' && permission?.granted; all other paths render Text/View fallback UI.
evidence: Separate denied and idle fallback renders

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement preview with `CameraView` and permission handling with `expo-camera` APIs used by the sample (`useCameraPermissions` with request/get methods, or `getCameraPermissionsAsync`/`requestCameraPermissionsAsync`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: CameraView and useCameraPermissions are imported from 'expo-camera' and used for preview and permission handling respectively.
